knowledge:
- key_parameters: path=Path to the directory containing the .tsv files to import ;; columns=Parameter in readImmunoSeq; set to "all" to import all columns, or specify a character vector of interest ;; aggregate=Parameter in productiveSeq; set to "aminoAcid" (sums counts for duplicate amino acid sequences and removes V, D, J columns) or "nucleotide" (retains all original columns) ;; prevalence=Parameter in productiveSeq; if TRUE, adds a column with the prevalence (%) of each TCR beta CDR3 amino acid sequence in 55 healthy donor peripheral blood samples ;; editDistance=Threshold for sequence similarity used in clonalRelatedness, alignSeq, and searchSeq ;; type=Specifies "aminoAcid" or "nucleotide" in phyloTree, alignSeq, searchSeq, and differentialAbundance ;; locus=Specifies "VDJ", "DJ", "VJ", "V", "D", or "J" in geneFreq ;; family=Set to TRUE in geneFreq to use family names instead of gene names
- alternatives: ImmunoSEQ analyzer v3 format is not supported; users must export in v2 format. Other platforms like MiXCR or IMGT/HighV-QUEST can be used if files are tab-delimited, have a .tsv extension, and use identical column names as ImmunoSEQ files. Multiple sequence alignment is performed using ClustalW, ClustalOmega, or Muscle from the msa package.
- when_to_use: Use this package when analyzing high-throughput sequencing of T and B lymphocyte antigen receptors to characterize repertoire diversity, compare multiple repertoires, track CDR3 sequences across samples, or search for sequences with known antigen specificity.
- pitfalls: Only files with the .tsv extension are imported. Adaptive Biotechnologies column names have changed over time; if headings differ, specify columns = "all" or provide all variations. Aggregating by "aminoAcid" in productiveSeq removes V, D, and J gene columns to avoid confusion, as a single amino acid sequence can be encoded by multiple nucleotide sequences.

workflows.name: tcr_bcr_repertoire_analysis
workflows.intent: Import, clean, and analyze T and B cell receptor sequencing data to characterize repertoire diversity, compare samples, and track clones.
input: sample_folder/ (directory containing tab-separated .tsv files exported from ImmunoSEQ analyzer v2)
metadata.csv (optional CSV file containing sample metadata for subsetting)
workflows.stages:
1. Import ImmunoSEQ files using readImmunoSeq.
2. Subset samples using metadata if necessary.
3. Extract productive sequences and aggregate by amino acid or nucleotide using productiveSeq.
4. Calculate repertoire diversity metrics (clonality, Gini coefficient) using clonality and visualize with lorenzCurve or topSeqsPlot.
5. Calculate clonal relatedness using clonalRelatedness and visualize sequence similarity using phyloTree.
6. Perform multiple sequence alignment using alignSeq.
7. Search for specific sequences using searchSeq or published TCRB sequences using searchPublished.
8. Compare samples pairwise using bhattacharyyaMatrix, similarityMatrix, and visualize with pairwisePlot, commonSeqsVenn, commonSeqsPlot, or commonSeqsBar.
9. Identify differentially abundant sequences using differentialAbundance.
10. Find recurring sequences using uniqueSeqs, seqMatrix, and topFreq.
11. Track sequences across samples using cloneTrack.
12. Analyze V(D)J gene usage using geneFreq and visualize with chordDiagramVDJ.
13. Remove contamination sequences using removeSeq.
14. Merge samples using mergeFiles.
workflows.code:
library(LymphoSeq)

TCRB.path <- system.file("extdata", "TCRB_sequencing", package = "LymphoSeq")

TCRB.list <- readImmunoSeq(path = TCRB.path)

names(TCRB.list)

lapply(TCRB.list, dim)

CMV <- TCRB.list[grep("CMV", names(TCRB.list))]
names(CMV)
TRB_Unsorted_0 <- TCRB.list[["TRB_Unsorted_0"]]
head(TRB_Unsorted_0)

TCRB.metadata <- read.csv(system.file("extdata", "TCRB_metadata.csv", package = "LymphoSeq"))
TCRB.metadata
selected <- as.character(TCRB.metadata[TCRB.metadata$phenotype == "Unsorted" & 
                                 TCRB.metadata$day > 300, "samples"])
TCRB.list.selected <- TCRB.list[selected]
names(TCRB.list.selected)

productive.TRB.aa <- productiveSeq(file.list = TCRB.list, aggregate = "aminoAcid", 
                               prevalence = FALSE)

productive.TRB.nt <- productiveSeq(file.list = TCRB.list, aggregate = "nucleotide", 
                               prevalence = FALSE)

head(TCRB.list[["TRB_Unsorted_0"]])

head(productive.TRB.aa[["TRB_Unsorted_0"]])

head(productive.TRB.nt[["TRB_Unsorted_0"]])

clonality(file.list = TCRB.list)

IGH.path <- system.file("extdata", "IGH_sequencing", package = "LymphoSeq")

IGH.list <- readImmunoSeq(path = IGH.path)

clonalRelatedness(list = IGH.list, editDistance = 10)

productive.IGH.nt <- productiveSeq(file.list = IGH.list, aggregate = "nucleotide")

phyloTree(list = productive.IGH.nt, sample = "IGH_MVQ92552A_BL", type = "nucleotide", 
         layout = "rectangular")

alignSeq(list = productive.IGH.nt, sample = "IGH_MVQ92552A_BL", type = "aminoAcid", 
         method = "ClustalW", output = "consule")

searchSeq(list = productive.TRB.aa, sequence = "CASSPVSNEQFF", type = "aminoAcid", 
          match = "global", editDistance = 0)

published <- searchPublished(list = productive.TRB.aa)
head(published)

lorenzCurve(samples = names(productive.TRB.aa), list = productive.TRB.aa)

topSeqsPlot(list = productive.TRB.aa, top = 10)

bhattacharyya.matrix <- bhattacharyyaMatrix(productive.seqs = productive.TRB.aa)
bhattacharyya.matrix
similarity.matrix <- similarityMatrix(productive.seqs = productive.TRB.aa)
similarity.matrix

pairwisePlot(matrix = bhattacharyya.matrix)

common <- commonSeqs(samples = c("TRB_Unsorted_0", "TRB_Unsorted_32"), 
                    productive.aa = productive.TRB.aa)
head(common)

commonSeqsVenn(samples = c("TRB_Unsorted_32", "TRB_Unsorted_83"), 
               productive.seqs = productive.TRB.aa)

commonSeqsVenn(samples = c("TRB_Unsorted_0", "TRB_Unsorted_32", "TRB_Unsorted_83"), 
               productive.seqs = productive.TRB.aa)

commonSeqsPlot("TRB_Unsorted_32", "TRB_Unsorted_83", 
               productive.aa = productive.TRB.aa, show = "common")

commonSeqsBar(productive.aa = productive.TRB.aa, 
              samples = c("TRB_CD4_949", "TRB_CD8_949", 
                          "TRB_Unsorted_949", "TRB_Unsorted_1320"), 
              color.sample = "TRB_CD8_949",
              labels = "no")

differentialAbundance(list = productive.TRB.aa, 
                      sample1 = "TRB_Unsorted_949", 
                      sample2 = "TRB_Unsorted_1320", 
                      type = "aminoAcid", q = 0.01)

unique.seqs <- uniqueSeqs(productive.aa = productive.TRB.aa)
head(unique.seqs)
sequence.matrix <- seqMatrix(productive.aa = productive.TRB.aa, sequences = unique.seqs$aminoAcid)
head(sequence.matrix)

top.freq <- topFreq(productive.aa = productive.TRB.aa, percent = 0.1)
head(top.freq)

top.freq <- topFreq(productive.aa = productive.TRB.aa, percent = 0)
top.freq.matrix <- merge(top.freq, sequence.matrix)
head(top.freq.matrix)

cloneTrack(sequence.matrix = sequence.matrix, 
           productive.aa = productive.TRB.aa, 
           map = c("TRB_CD4_949", "TRB_CD8_949"), 
           label = c("CD4", "CD8"), 
           track = "CASSPPTGERDTQYF", 
           unassigned = FALSE)

vGenes <- geneFreq(productive.nt = productive.TRB.nt, locus = "V", family = TRUE)
head(vGenes)

top.seqs <- topSeqs(productive.seqs = productive.TRB.nt, top = 1)
chordDiagramVDJ(sample = top.seqs, 
                association = "VJ", 
                colors = c("darkred", "navyblue"))

searchSeq(list = productive.TRB.aa, sequence = "CASSESAGSTGELFF")
cleansed <- removeSeq(file.list = productive.TRB.aa, sequence = "CASSESAGSTGELFF")
searchSeq(list = cleansed, sequence = "CASSESAGSTGELFF")

TRB_949_Merged <- mergeFiles(samples = c("TRB_CD4_949", "TRB_CD8_949"), 
                                file.list = TCRB.list)
